Coram : M.R. SHAH*, A.S. BOPANNA
Negotiable Instruments Act, 1882: s.138 – Respondent no.2 obtained financial assistance of Rs.2 crore from the appellant due to previous acquaintance and assured that the amount would be returned in June/July 2015 – Towards were handed over to appellant – Based on assurance of payment, appellant presented the cheques for realisation in October 2015, however same were dishonoured on account of insufficiency of funds – Appellant filed complaint under s.420 IPC and also under s.138 NI Act – Respondent
